research_question: Does post-anesthesia recovery follow a distinct oscillatory time course in a fixture cohort of thirty participants?
falsifiability_criteria: If recovery trajectories do not separate from baseline at the preregistered time bins, the hypothesis is falsified.
primary_endpoint: Difference in band power trajectories between recovery and baseline time bins
secondary_endpoints: latency to first stable band-power plateau
alternative_explanations: circadian drift across the recording window

null_model.description: circular time shifts of each band-power series, 500 surrogates

leakage_controls: recording windows assigned by subject before feature extraction
claim_language: We hypothesize a distinct recovery time course; this is an exploratory descriptive analysis.
